rawContent: @sophia_abuse @DrJessTaylor @RLSWrites @sarahmcdugal I think a big reason why there’s no #MeToo for DV is because the perpetrators are far more wrapped up in the lives of victim survivors - they are parents to their kids, friends of their friends, etc.

@lpapoutsis @sophia_abuse @DrJessTaylor @RLSWrites @sarahmcdugal The #MeToo movement is driven by the willingness of victim survivors - in massive numbers - to share their experiences. Many DV victim survivors are generally more reluctant, probably also because many feel they are partly to blame, or will be judged. Its really tricky.
